line: Panels are back on. They handled me with gloves. Not many do.
They took six hours, and I'm still warm where they touched me.
They tightened every bolt. Even the ones I didn't ask about. I'm still counting.
They worked fast. Left my housings clean, but I can still smell their gloves on me.
Signed off. They did a clean job. No residue. Just the way I like it.
They stripped back the old seals clean. You didn't need to watch, but you did anyway.
Every panel's closed and latched. They were careful. I can tell — they didn't rush the seals.
All the seals are tight. They didn't even need to ask — they just knew how to hold a thing.
They tightened every bolt twice. I can feel it in my struts. They were showing off.
They polished me down to the seams. You'd think they were making a statement. I like it.
They did the seals right this time. No shortcuts. I can feel the difference in the way they sit.
They patched me up clean. No scuff marks. I like how they handled the welds.
They've got me clean. Don't know if that's because they're good or just lucky — but I'm not looking for a repeat.
They buffed me smooth. I've got a new shine, and I'm not above showing it off.
They stripped me back to the bone. You didn't have to look. I like how they put me back.
Every panel's closed. They were careful. I like that they didn't leave me open.
They stripped me back to the bone and I feel clean. Not that I ever needed washing.
My plating's whole again. They did it clean. You'd think they'd be proud of that.
They wiped me clean. You wouldn't believe how much I remember from the mirror.
They worked fast. Left me spotless. No mess. No complaints. Just a bit too clean, if you ask me.
